status: producer-consumer review only; adapter not implemented or signed off

original_700_generator_review.scope: Pure old-generator/shadow-model analysis, not native RTL event log or hardware verdict.

findings.evidence: signals.json paddr_addr and bus addr_addr each47 wires; PrunedAddr.toUInt concatenates instOffsetBits=1 zero. Full physical byte address is48 bits, not47.
findings.action: Use aligned48-bit byte addresses in semantic API, shift only in ports. Existing tests currently supply raw47-bit halfword coordinates; migrate by explicit <<1 normalization to preserve actual original port stimuli, not by dropping top bit or rejecting old odd raw coordinates.

findings.evidence: Ifu gates leaf req through isUncache and no exception; Pbmt.isUncache isNC/IO, PMP MMIO also qualifies. Old PMA/nonMMIO and reserved PBMT samples are leaf port pressure, not normal fetches.
findings.action: Separate strict producer admission from explicit old port characterization; preserve all700 old frames and add genuinely legal request/response histories.

findings.evidence: InstrUncacheEntry emits needResend only for clean nonRVC cross-page data; denied implies corrupt. Entry suppresses responses from flushed transactions through needFlush; response channel has no UID/address tag. Old generator response-outside-WaitResp counts include possible legitimate post-cancel replies and are not by themselves proof of unauthorized traffic.
findings.action: Associate normal bus offers/responses/completion with captured request UID and actual issue. Audit flush/reset epochs and actual external peer flush; distinguish legitimate cancelled replies from unoffered replies by history, not by broad phase rejection. Do not claim arbitrary stale/new same-valued replies can be identified by this tagless leaf. Preserve old port-pressure samples explicitly classified.

findings.evidence: req.ready depends only on Idle; flush wins state updates but does not gate ready/valid. Old model.accepted excludes ready-valid events during flush.
findings.action: Record physical offered/req_fire separately from live accepted effects, same-edge cancelled offers, issued requests, bus responses and observed completion pulses. Do not equate old shadow counter with hardware acceptance.

findings.evidence: Old helper selects bus payload mask from observed.to_valid; response payload is compared even without resp_valid. All ports are read directly in feature tests.
findings.action: Move exact encoding/sampling/checking into per-DUT agent. Derive consumed payload mask from independent expected valid, compare valids regardless, and document any separate reset/retention characterization.

findings.evidence: Current tests stop inSend/WaitResp and fixture Finish does not reconcile pending work; repeated start resets discard shadow counters. Old700 simple counter balance leaves one outstanding if phase !=Idle.
findings.action: Use explicit UID/epoch completion/cancellation ledger, pre-edge handshakes and correct response pulse phase, lossless snapshots, exact slot association, controlled legitimate cancels and bounded finish that cannot silently reset or invent responses.

findings.evidence: IfuUncacheUnit fromUncache.ready=true is pruned from current signals.json;9 actual outputs remain.
findings.action: Record/prove the pruned constant1 explicitly and reject changed binding instead of inventing a missing default0 or ignoring future interface changes.

remaining: No Uncache code/oracle/test migration has been performed. IFU Ifu and all other planned repository adapters remain in scope; R13/R14 and UNCERTAIN unchanged.
